entities.name: Battle of Gettysburg
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: Site of the bloodiest battle of the American Civil War (July 1-3, 1863) in Pennsylvania, where Union forces repelled Robert E. Lee's invasion of the North. With over 50,000 casualties, Gettysburg marked the turning point of the war and became — through Lincoln's Gettysburg Address — America's most sacred battlefield and a symbol of democratic ideals.
